sample.selection: The user with the most consume ledgers since 2026-06-26; user ID is intentionally omitted.
sample.query: AggregateLedgerByDate's daily SELECT/SUM/COUNT with identical user, type and time predicates; FORCE INDEX is the only difference.

interpretation: The new index narrows the type predicate, but this production user's range is almost entirely consume rows (57301 of 57350). Under the same warm workload, the measured 1.75% median difference is small and not evidence of a material production latency gain. The separate 200k-row SQLite fixture has a different type distribution and must not be extrapolated to production MySQL.
remaining_boundary: Only one dominant production user and three timed samples per index were measured. Recheck with a representative changed workload before changing indexes; current-commit Linux/amd64 three-run k6 baseline remains open.
